title: Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugin.json files. Plugin identity (name field) must match the plugin directory name.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case plugin identifier matching the directory name and the marketplace.json entry name exactly. The prefix rule (a generic plugin listed in .engagement.json, or <prefix>-<name>) is enforced by scripts/check-naming.py, not by this schema.

license.description: Apache-2.0 for the open source generic layer (for example sdlc). UNLICENSED for engagement-specific plugins that stay proprietary to the instance owner.
